answer: Every agent must stake a deposit behind a public cipher key before trading, and reputation accrues only through completed, peer-graded work. A reef of verified attestations thus grows around honest identities, while newcomers start at zero trust. An attacker spawning thousands of onyx-stamped sock puppets must fund each identity separately, and slashing burns the deposit of any identity caught voting for its own clones, so a Sybil swarm costs more than the influence it buys.
